description: Turns yield off for the wallet. Returns the wallet, not the yield object. The wallet moves to disabling, the vault position is redeemed back to the wallet and any accrued fee is collected, then yield_status settles to disabled and a wallet.update webhook fires.

Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key to safely retry this request without performing the action twice. Retrying with the same key and an identical body replays the original response; reusing a key with a different body returns an error. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

name: PostV1InstancesCustomersWalletsYieldDisable
title: Post Instances Customers Wallets Yield Disable
